{{Quote|Sir, there appears to be a disturbance in Hangar 9-4.|A 501st Legion clone trooper to Jedi General Krell|<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
'''Hangar 9-4''' served as a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay in a [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]] and was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|battle]] took place on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] and this hangar was part of an [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|airbase]] that was resupplying the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital]]. Sometime during the battle the airbase was captured by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] and this hangar was used by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] and [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] for pilot training to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|Supply ship]]. This hangar was partially destroyed as a result of the flying lesson.<ref name="Plan of Dissent" />
